required_fields: four selected shaft faces at WT-A from WT-T-SF1..SF5
four selected shaft faces at WT-C from WT-T-SF1..SF5
mapping of A-F1..F4 and C-F1..F4 to those selected source faces
lateral face-local position u for each anchor, or an explicit rule that determines it
cable target pairing only where intended/current topology is explicit
geometry_aids_not_decisions: NW_P1..P4 plan directions align most closely with source shaft face WT-T-SF4.
SE_P1..P4 plan directions align most closely with source shaft face WT-T-SF2.
E_candidate lies close to the plan-direction bisector between WT-T-SF1 and WT-T-SF5, so nearest-face geometry does not uniquely assign it.
owner_decision_packet.non_default_rule: No face exclusion, anchor midline placement, A/C elevation or cable pairing is auto-selected.

required_QA: all anchor points lie on selected source shaft faces
no anchor outside Pad004 z range
no structural cable edge without both endpoints bound
semantic-map version/hash attached to every derived endpoint/edge

guardrails: The five geometric shaft faces are source facts; the four-anchor owner topology is preserved and not expanded to five anchors.
A-F1..F4/C-F1..F4 are anchor semantic identifiers, not automatically equivalent to shaft-face ordinals SF1..SF5.
Local-CAD azimuths are not geodetic bearings.
Geometric face incidence does not establish cable design, load path, pretension or structural adequacy.
